nodes.label: Build and Deploy Docker Image Workflow
nodes.norm_label: build and deploy docker image workflow

nodes.label: Framer Motion Animations (stagger, popLayout rows)
nodes.rationale: Radix modals use data-state CSS animations and must not be wrapped in AnimatePresence because Radix controls mount/unmount internally.

nodes.label: Design System (indigo primary, mirrors homeauto)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors sibling homeauto dashboard globals.css for visual consistency; --accent kept as neutral hover surface per shadcn semantics, never brand color; CSS Modules use hsl(var(--primary)/x) with no hardcoded colors.

nodes.label: Important Rules (non-dismissible modals, textarea auto-resize)
nodes.rationale: Protects Redux shape, API routes, Zod schemas and RHF logic from unrequested changes; onInteractOutside prevention in Modal.tsx is intentional; focus rings indigo.

nodes.label: MongoDB Connection (per-call, no pooling)
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded mongodb://localhost:27017/recipies with IPv4 forced; each API call opens and closes its own connection.

nodes.label: FOUC-free Theme Persistence (dark default)
nodes.rationale: Inline blocking script in <head> reads localStorage before React hydrates to avoid flash of wrong theme; dark is default, light only when localStorage.theme === 'light'.
